note.label: WHEN IN DOUBT
note.value: Carry small USD notes and keep one offline copy of every booking.

items.question: Do I need a visa for Cambodia?
items.answer: Most travellers can use an e-visa or obtain a visa on arrival. The e-visa is the calmer option: apply before the trip, print a copy, and check that your entry point accepts it.
